context: Three men dinner — colleagues becoming real friends. They share over the months.
purpose: three-male deepening adult friendship — work-bonds becoming personal

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 三人で集まる回数、増えたな。嬉しいわ。
lines.en: We're getting together more often now — all three of us. That makes me really happy.
lines.style: Warm, reflective opening. Kansai lilt threading through naturally. Soft genuine smile in the voice. Settles into gratitude without performing it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 本当に。最初は、職場の関係だったのに。
lines.en: Really. And to think at first it was just a work thing.
lines.style: Quiet wonder underneath. Gentle, almost amazed tone. No rush — lets the observation sit. Real warmth, no artifice.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 不思議ですね。仕事で出会って、こうなるって。
lines.en: It's strange, isn't it. Meeting through work and becoming like this.
lines.style: Steady, slightly philosophical. Soft surprise in the delivery. Eyes-up, present. Warmth that comes from actually being there.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: わいは、東京来てよかったって、こういう時思う。
lines.en: Times like this, I think — I'm glad I came to Tokyo.
lines.style: Kansai warmth with real vulnerability underneath. Lets the confession land. Soft, genuine. Not loud — intimate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 俺も、同じ気持ちです。お二人がいなかったら、こんなに楽しくなかった。
lines.en: Same here. Without you two, it wouldn't be this much fun.
lines.style: Sincere and direct. Slight catch of feeling on 'you two.' Gentle, no performance. Lets it be simple.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 私は、お二人より少し年上ですけど、教わることばっかりで。
lines.en: I'm a bit older than you both, but honestly — I learn from you constantly.
lines.style: Humble, not false. Warm redirect that's actually sincere. Slow enough to mean it. Quiet authority underneath.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: いやいや、亮介さんから、わいら学ぶことばっかり。
lines.en: No, no — we're the ones learning from Ryosuke-san.
lines.style: Warm deflection with real affection. Kansai swing audible. Playful but genuine underneath. Quick-bright opening, settles into sincerity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: こういう関係、人生で、何度ないですよね。
lines.en: You don't get friendships like this very often in life, do you.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. Slight wonder. Lets the truth sit without needing to amplify it. Warm, grounded.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 本当に。家族とはまた違う、仲間ですね。
lines.en: You really don't. It's different from family — this is companionship.
lines.style: Gentle, philosophical. A small pause before 'companionship' — the word has weight. Steady, present.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 将来、おじいちゃんになっても、こうやって飲もな。
lines.en: Even when we're old men, let's keep drinking like this together.
lines.style: Bright commitment. Kansai warmth. Future-focused but grounded in now. Playful and sincere at once.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 約束ですね。絶対、続けましょう。
lines.en: A promise. We'll definitely keep it going.
lines.style: Firm, gentle commitment. Direct eye contact in the voice. No hesitation, real conviction. Warm closing.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 感謝の気持ち、ちゃんと、言わせてください。
lines.en: I want to say this properly — thank you. I really mean it.
lines.style: Opens slightly vulnerable. Slow, letting each word land. Deep sincerity. Not rushed. Real emotion, no theatrics.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: No — it's us who should be thanking you.
lines.style: Warm, quick return. Kansai lilt gentle. Genuine reciprocal gratitude, not deflection. Bright undertone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: もう一杯、いきましょう。
lines.style: Light, warm gathering-together. Simple, forward. Gentle brightness. Pulls the moment forward with ease.
